ingredients.item: skirt or flank steak, trimmed of excess fat if necessary, at room temperature
ingredients.item_scaled: skirt or flank steak, trimmed of excess fat if necessary, at room temperature

recipes.steps_html:
1. Put the mustard, vinegar, Worcestershire, and honey in a jar, add the 2 1/2 Tbsp oil, and shake to mix.
  2. Pat the steak dry and season both sides with 1/4 tsp salt and plenty of black pepper.
  3. Cook the steak one of two ways:
    • Cast-iron skillet: heat over medium-high to high and add the oil. When it shimmers, lay in the steak and leave it alone 5 minutes. Flip once and cook 3 minutes more for medium-rare.
    • Grill: set up for direct heat over hot charcoal, or high on gas. Oil the grate and grill the steak (lid down on a gas grill), flipping once, 4 to 6 minutes total for medium-rare.
  4. Rest the steak on a cutting board, loosely tented with foil, 5 minutes.
  5. Spread the arugula on a large platter. Slice the steak thinly on the diagonal, across the grain, and lay it over the arugula. Scatter the radishes and blue cheese on top, dress to taste, and sprinkle with scallions.

  8. Nuoc cham: stir the lime juice and sugar until the sugar dissolves, then add the rest, tasting and adjusting.
  9. Serve the rolls right away with both sauces.
recipes.notes_html:
• The pork is the Barbecued Pork recipe on the Banh Mi with Viet Fries card from the same handout; make it ahead (the handout's note to the instructor says it was made before class).
  • The rest of the class menu has its own cards: Banh Mi with Viet Fries, Pho Bo, Shrimp in Tamarind Sauce, and Tangerines in Ginger Syrup.
  • The handout writes teaspoon as "t." and tablespoon as "T."; this card uses tsp and Tbsp.

recipes.title: White Pizza (Ryan's)
recipes.source: Ryan (own note, "White Pizza by Ryan")
recipes.description: Two sheet-pan white pizzas brushed with garlic oil and topped with mozzarella, pecorino, and herbed ricotta, finished with the fried garlic chips, herbs, and red pepper flakes.

ingredients.text: 1 lb pizza dough, divided in half
Crushed red pepper flakes, for garnish

recipes.steps_html:
1. Preheat oven to 500 F. Brush two large baking sheets with vegetable oil and sprinkle each with a layer of cornmeal.
  2. In a small sauce pan over medium-low heat, heat olive oil. Add garlic and stir until lightly golden, then immediately remove from heat. Strain garlic and season with a pinch of salt. Reserve oil, and set both aside.
  3. In a small bowl, mix together ricotta, salt, pepper, and half the herbs.
  4. On a lightly floured surface, shape each half of pizza dough into a round ball, then press down the center of each to create a 1/2" crust. With the dough resting on the back of your hands and your knuckles, gently stretch dough out with the help of gravity by moving your hands inch by inch along the crust. Transfer to prepared baking sheets.
  5. Brush each pizza dough all over with reserved garlic oil. Sprinkle each pie with 1 cup mozzarella and 2 tablespoons pecorino, then dollop 3/4 cup of ricotta mixture on each pizza.
  6. Bake pizzas until crust is golden and cheese is melty, 15 to 17 minutes.
  7. Garnish with remaining herbs, reserved garlic chips, and red pepper flakes before slicing and serving.
recipes.notes_html:
• Serves estimate: two pizzas from 1 lb of dough, at about half a pizza per adult.
  • Time: the 15 to 17 minute bake plus about 30 minutes to heat the oven, make the garlic oil and ricotta, and stretch the dough; an estimate.
  • Dough: the note does not say which. The dough on Pizza Dough and White Pizza makes roughly 1 1/2 lb, so about two thirds of that batch.
  • This is a different recipe from the Pizza Bianco on that card, which is written for a countertop pizza oven; this one is for a regular oven.

recipes.title: Zesty Lime Shrimp and Avocado Salad
recipes.source: Skinnytaste
recipes.description: Light, no-mayo shrimp salad with avocado, tomato, jalapeno, red onion, and cilantro in fresh lime juice.

ingredients.text: 1 lb jumbo cooked shrimp, peeled, deveined, and chopped (weight after peeling)
ingredients.item: jumbo cooked shrimp, peeled, deveined, and chopped (weight after peeling)
ingredients.item_scaled: jumbo cooked shrimp, peeled, deveined, and chopped (weight after peeling)

ingredients.text: Salt and fresh pepper, to taste

recipes.steps_html:
1. In a small bowl, mix the red onion with the lime juice, olive oil, and a pinch of salt and pepper. Let it sit at least 5 minutes to mellow the onion.
  2. In a large bowl, combine the shrimp, avocado, tomato, and jalapeno.
  3. Add the onion mixture and the cilantro, toss gently, and adjust the salt and pepper.
recipes.notes_html:
• Skinnytaste's 4 servings are about 7/8 cup each (3 1/2 cups total). As a main-dish salad at about 1 1/2 cups each, the batch is closer to 2 servings.
  • To make ahead, combine everything except the avocado and cilantro and refrigerate; add those two just before serving. The recipe doubles easily.
  • Serve as is, over lettuce, or on tostadas.
  • Skinnytaste lists about 210 calories and 25 g protein per serving (5 Weight Watchers Points+).
